manifesto.titulo: A brand is forged with care. And it has to stay alive in every piece of work.
manifesto.lead: Brennimark, in Icelandic, is the fire brand: the sign burned in with iron that said who something belonged to. The English word brand comes from the same idea of burning.
manifesto.p1: It has been more than forty years of design and art direction. In almost all of them, the same difficulty came back: the deadline running, the manual in a long PDF, the files scattered across folders and the answer that took too long to arrive.
manifesto.pull1: Brennimark is the help I always wanted to have.
manifesto.p2: A brand is born from the careful work of the people who create it: the drawing of the symbol, the weight of each letter, the exact color, the space around it. Then it goes on to many hands: the agency, the supplier, the printer, whoever has just joined the team. Each one carries the idea forward.
manifesto.p3: Brennimark brings together the manual as the studio designed it, the up-to-date materials and the guidance the brand gains over time. Vini helps find the answer, with the source, so that time goes back to what matters: thinking, researching and creating.
manifesto.p4: A living brand is not a rigid brand. It evolves, gains new guidance and sometimes reinvents itself, and everyone needs to follow the current version.
manifesto.p5: We respect the authorship of those who created it and the decision of those who apply it. We don't invent rules, and we say clearly when there is no safe answer.
manifesto.pull2: Forged with care. Alive in every piece of work.

studio.titulo: Studio is where the agency looks after all its brands.
studio.corpo: Publish manuals, organize materials, write supplements, invite people and follow everything, brand by brand, in one place.
studio.portasTitulo: Studio for those who manage. Book for those who consult.
studio.portasCorpo: The same brand, two experiences. Whoever only needs to use the brand never runs into editing tools.
studio.studioTexto: Publishes the manual, organizes the materials, writes supplements, invites people and follows the records.
studio.bookTexto: Reads the manual, downloads the materials and asks Vini. Without a single button that isn't meant for them.
studio.statusTitulo: What is approved, what is a draft, and who decides.
studio.statusCorpo: Every item has a status: draft, in review or published. Adding an image or a text doesn't change the status; only the approval of whoever manages the brand does. The team and Vini use what is published.
studio.t3: Vini only cites what is published
studio.rascunhoTexto: The agency assembles, uploads and writes.
studio.publicadoTexto: The team sees it, and Vini starts citing it.
studio.a1: Whoever subscribes and the people they give the role of managing a brand.
studio.a2: Yes, each with their own access. No shared passwords.
studio.q3: Does the agency's client see Studio?
studio.a3: Only if the agency wants them to administer the brand too. To consult, they use Book.

empresas.d2b: Access by brand, revoked in one click
empresas.d3a: Each supplier with a different file
empresas.d4a: Manual kept with the former agency
empresas.d4b: The brand stays with the company

empresas.q1: Our agency already uses Brennimark. How does it work?
empresas.a1: The agency manages the brand in Studio and invites your team to consult. If you prefer, the subscription can be the company's.
empresas.q2: We have several brands and units.
empresas.a2: The Corporate plan is made for that, with a tailored proposal.
empresas.a3: Yes. The brand stays with you, and the previous agency's access is revoked.

complementos.o_que_o_manual_nao: What the manual doesn't say, the agency writes. And Vini starts citing it.
complementos.texto_simples_publicado_ao_lado: Plain text, published next to the manual.
complementos.a_lacuna_fechada_vira_resposta: A closed gap becomes an answer.
complementos.o_editor_de_complemento_o: The supplement editor: the text on the left and the preview on the right
complementos.todo_manual_tem_lacunas_o: Every manual has gaps. Brennimark shows which ones they are, through the team's questions, and lets the agency answer with a supplement, without redoing the PDF.
complementos.a_agencia_escreve_o_complemento: The agency writes the supplement in plain text, with headings and lists. It goes through approval and appears in the Supplements tab, next to the PDF.
complementos.depois_de_aprovado_o_complemento: Once approved, the supplement becomes part of what Vini knows. The same question now gets an answer, with the source.
complementos.posso_usar_o_simbolo_sobre: Can I use the symbol over a photo?
complementos.o_manual_nao_trata_disso: The manual doesn't cover this. There is a supplement in draft, which doesn't count as a rule yet. It's worth confirming with whoever manages the brand.
complementos.sim_em_areas_escuras_e: Yes, on dark, untextured areas, in the white version and with the protection area doubled. Never over a face.
complementos.fonte_complemento_simbolo_sobre_fotograf: Source: Supplement "Symbol over photography" · approved on Sep 20
complementos.o_complemento_muda_o_pdf: Does the supplement change the PDF?
complementos.nao_o_pdf_continua_como: No. The PDF stays as the studio delivered it; the supplement sits next to it, clearly labeled.
complementos.quem_gere_a_marca_a: Whoever manages the brand. Publishing goes through approval.
complementos.o_relatorio_mostra_quem_perguntou: Does the report show who asked?
complementos.nao_so_o_assunto_e: No. Only the topic and how many times, and only when enough people are asking that no one can be identified.

entrega.cada_fornecedor_com_a_versao: Every supplier with the current version of the brand.
entrega.para_quem_nao_tem_conta: For people without an account, a link that expires.
entrega.cada_pessoa_ve_so_a: Each person sees only the brand they work on.
entrega.a_pagina_que_a_grafica: The page the printer receives, without creating an account: the name of whoever downloads, the files chosen and the manual's rule with its pages
entrega.os_registros_quem_baixou_qual: The records: who downloaded which material, when and in which brand
entrega.pessoas_e_acesso_cada_pessoa: People and access: each person with their level and the brands they can reach
entrega.envie_materiais_a_quem_nao: Send materials to people without an account using a link that expires, invite each person to the brands they work on and keep everyone on the same reference.
entrega.escolha_os_materiais_e_o: Choose the materials and the deadline. The link stops working on its own, and every use is recorded.
entrega.sem_criar_conta_para_o: No account to create for the supplier
entrega.a_fonte_fica_de_fora: The font is left out: only brand members download it
entrega.envios_e_downloads_ficam_no: Deliveries and downloads stay in the same history. When someone asks "did the printer receive the new logo?", the answer is there. The record shows access and downloads; it doesn't show how the brand was applied to a piece.
entrega.downloads_e_envios_num_so: Downloads and deliveries in one place
entrega.filtro_por_marca_pessoa_e: Filter by brand, person and period
entrega.uma_agencia_com_vinte_marcas: An agency with twenty brands invites the photographer only to the brand of the shoot. Two simple roles: whoever manages and whoever consults.
entrega.quem_consulta_le_baixa_e: Whoever consults reads, downloads and asks
entrega.mude_o_papel_quando_quiser: Change the role whenever you like
entrega.o_fornecedor_precisa_criar_conta: Does the supplier need to create an account?
entrega.nao_se_voce_usar_o: No, if you use the delivery link. For people who work on the brand every day, an invitation is better.
entrega.posso_cancelar_um_link_antes: Can I cancel a link before the deadline?
entrega.sim_a_qualquer_momento_ele: Yes, at any time. It stops working right away.
entrega.quantas_pessoas_posso_convidar: How many people can I invite?

manual.encontre_a_regra_pelo_capitulo: Find the rule by chapter or by a word.
manual.retrato_paisagem_e_16_9: Portrait, landscape and 16:9, with or without a table of contents. Without one, Brennimark proposes an index for you to check.
manual.nada_de_reconstruir_o_manual: No rebuilding the manual in a new tool. Brennimark reads the file you already have, and it's ready to consult, for Vini and for the materials.
manual.o_vini_passa_a_consultar: Vini starts consulting the published manual
manual.nova_versao_substitui_a_anterior: A new version replaces the previous one with one upload
manual.pronto_o_tempo_de_leitura: Done. Reading time varies with the size of the file.
manual.tipografia_grid_cor_e_respiro: Typography, grid, color and white space arrive intact. The manual is a studio's work, and Brennimark doesn't touch it.
manual.o_pdf_que_o_estudio: The PDF the studio laid out
manual.a_busca_percorre_o_texto: Search runs through the text of every page and shows the passage with the word, so you can go straight to the point.
manual.busca_no_texto_de_todas: Search across the text of every page
manual.clique_e_o_manual_abre: Click and the manual opens on the page
manual.o_mesmo_arquivo_que_o: The same file the studio delivered to the client.
manual.veja_o_indice_ajuste_um: See the index, adjust a title if needed and publish.
manual.no_book_com_indice_busca: In Book, with index, search, materials and Vini.
manual.preciso_refazer_o_manual_em: Do I need to redo the manual in another tool?
manual.nao_voce_sobe_o_pdf: No. You upload the PDF that already exists, and it is the reading surface.
manual.e_se_o_pdf_nao: What if the PDF has no table of contents?
manual.o_brennimark_monta_um_indice: Brennimark builds an index from the page titles, and you can adjust it in Studio.
manual.posso_publicar_uma_versao_nova: Can I publish a new version?
manual.sim_a_nova_substitui_a: Yes. The new one replaces the previous one for the team, and the history is recorded.
manual.sim_se_quem_gere_a: Yes, if whoever manages the brand allows it. The download is recorded.

materiais.tudo_que_a_marca_precisa: Everything the brand needs, ready to download.
materiais.o_kit_inteiro_montado_na: The whole kit, assembled on the spot.
materiais.quem_baixa_o_logo_leva: Whoever downloads the logo takes how to use it along.
materiais.o_logo_antigo_nao_se: The old logo won't be mistaken for the current one.
materiais.a_agencia_organiza_uma_vez: The agency organizes once. The team uses it always.
materiais.entregue_a_marca_pronta_para: Deliver the brand ready to use.
materiais.materiais_da_marca_a_lista: Brand materials: the list of Brennimark files, each with its thumbnail
materiais.painel_de_montagem_do_kit: Kit assembly panel with six groups checked and the progress bar
materiais.a_pagina_de_um_item: An item page: the file preview, the usage rule with the manual's pages and the download button

materiais.logo_simbolo_cores_fonte_icones: Logo, symbol, colors, font, icons and photography in one place. Every file with its usage rule attached, and the whole kit in one click.
materiais.tudo_o_que_a_marca: Everything the brand has, in a single package, in the right formats.
materiais.cada_arquivo_leva_a_regra: Every file carries its usage rule and the manual page.
materiais.para_quem_e_da_marca: For those who are part of the brand, with the license in order.
materiais.o_que_saiu_de_uso: Whatever went out of use is marked as discontinued.
materiais.escolha_o_que_precisa_ou: Choose what you need or take everything. The package is assembled in your own browser and arrives organized in folders, ready to hand to whoever will produce.
materiais.logo_em_svg_png_e: Logo in SVG, PNG and PDF
materiais.paleta_em_ase_com_hex: Palette in ASE, with HEX, RGB and CMYK
materiais.as_regras_de_uso_em: Usage rules in PDF, inside the package
materiais.montando_o_pacote_no_seu: Assembling the package in your browser… 68%
materiais.cada_item_tem_as_suas: Each item has its versions and, beside them, the rule that applies to it, with the manual page. The supplier doesn't have to guess, and no one has to explain again.
materiais.versoes_para_fundo_claro_e: Versions for light and dark backgrounds
materiais.o_que_pode_e_o: What is allowed and what isn't, side by side
materiais.a_citacao_abre_o_manual: The citation opens the manual on the page
materiais.sem_a_fonte_o_primeiro: Without the font, the first file opened already comes out wrong. In Brennimark it stays with the rest of the brand, to download, and only for those who are part of it.
materiais.so_para_membros_daquela_marca: Only for members of that brand
materiais.licenca_aceita_e_registrada_no: License accepted and recorded at upload
materiais.download_para_membros_desta_marca: Download for members of this brand.
materiais.licenca_aceita_por_carolina_menezes: License accepted by Carolina Menezes on March 12, 2026, when the files were uploaded.
materiais.albuns_por_assunto_com_miniaturas: Albums by subject, with thumbnails and enlargement of each image. Select one, several or all and download at once.
materiais.quando_um_arquivo_sai_de: When a file goes out of use, it doesn't disappear: it is marked as discontinued, with the date. Whoever searches finds the current one first.
materiais.o_descontinuado_continua_disponivel_para: The discontinued one remains available for consultation, with a notice, and is not included in the kit.
materiais.no_studio_cada_arquivo_entra: In Studio, each file goes into its group: logotype, colors, font, icons, photos.
materiais.liga_cada_um_a_regra: Links each one to its rule
materiais.a_regra_de_uso_e: The usage rule and the manual page stay attached to the file.
materiais.a_equipe_baixa_o_que: The team downloads what it needs
materiais.um_arquivo_um_grupo_ou: One file, one group or the whole kit, always the current version.
materiais.as_pessoas_convidadas_para_aquela: The people invited to that brand. An agency with twenty brands invites each supplier only to the brand they work on.
materiais.e_quem_nao_tem_conta: And people without an account, like the printer?
materiais.voce_envia_um_link_de: You send a delivery link with a deadline, with logo, colors, photos and usage rules. It expires on its own. The font doesn't go by link: it is only for brand members.
materiais.nao_ela_e_servida_so: No. It is served for download only, to authenticated members of that brand, after the license is accepted at upload. It never becomes a public address.
materiais.os_de_uso_comum_em: The ones commonly used in branding: SVG, PNG, JPG, PDF, EPS, AI, OTF, TTF, ASE and others. The file size limit depends on the plan.
materiais.o_que_acontece_com_o: What happens to the old logo?
materiais.fica_marcado_como_descontinuado_com: It is marked as discontinued, with a date. It remains searchable, but is not included in the kit and appears after the current one.

seguranca.a_marca_do_seu_cliente: Your client's brand is confidential. Brennimark treats it that way.
seguranca.seis_principios_de_protecao_desde: Six protection principles, from the way the product is designed.
seguranca.a_interface_mostra_o_banco: The interface shows. The database decides.
seguranca.pessoas_e_acesso_cada_pessoa: People and access: each person with their level and the brands they can reach
seguranca.campanha_antes_do_ar_fonte: Campaign before launch, licensed font, original files. Every product decision starts from one question: who can see this?
seguranca.a_fronteira_e_a_marca: The boundary is the brand, not the account. Whoever works on one brand doesn't see the others, and that is guaranteed in the database, not only on the screen.
seguranca.ninguem_le_a_conversa_de: No one reads another person's conversation with Vini: not the account owner, not our team.
seguranca.a_fonte_da_marca_e: The brand font is served for download only, to authenticated members, with the license accepted. No public address.
seguranca.as_chaves_de_ia_ficam: AI keys are stored encrypted and never leave in a server response.
seguranca.publicacoes_convites_e_downloads_ficam: Publications, invitations and downloads are recorded, with author and date.
seguranca.ao_encerrar_a_assinatura_a: When the subscription ends, the account is frozen for a period and you export everything beforehand.
seguranca.o_que_aparece_na_tela: What appears on screen depends on the person's role; what they can read is decided in the database, rule by rule. A forgotten screen opens no door.
seguranca.testes_que_provam_que_a: Tests that prove A can't read B
seguranca.para_melhorar_o_produto_usamos: To improve the product we use aggregate numbers: most-asked topics, most common gaps. No specific conversation is read.
seguranca.ninguem_le_a_conversa_de_2: No one reads another person's conversation: not the account owner, not the Brennimark team. We use statistics only, without identifying who asked.
seguranca.quando_quiser_fica_so_o: whenever they like. Only the usage record stays, without the content.
seguranca.em_armazenamento_privado_separado_por: In private storage, separated by brand. No file has a permanent public address.
seguranca.a_equipe_do_brennimark_acessa: Does the Brennimark team access my account?
seguranca.para_suporte_acessa_registros_e: For support, it accesses records and settings. Conversations, never: only if you send one to support.
seguranca.sim_de_verdade_fica_so: Yes, for real. Only the usage record stays, without content.
seguranca.a_conta_fica_congelada_por: The account is frozen for a period, you export everything, and then the data is deleted.

vini.quando_o_cliente_pergunta_eu: When the client asks, I open the manual page together with them. The conversation stays on the idea, not on the file.
vini.o_vini_max_ajuda_voce: Vini Max helps you work with the brand.
vini.pergunte_como_perguntaria_a_um: Ask the way you'd ask a colleague who knows the brand.
vini.solte_a_peca_ele_faz: Drop in the piece. Vini takes a second look.
vini.a_sua_ideia_com_a: Your idea, with the brand in the prompt.
vini.no_canto_de_cada_tela: In the corner of every brand screen.
vini.traga_o_vini_para_perto: Bring Vini closer to your team.
vini.vini_max_o_assistente_do: Vini Max, the Brennimark assistant, with round glasses and a black turtleneck, holding a book
vini.a_revisao_de_uma_peca: The review of a piece: the assistant marks what is outside the manual's rules, with the page of each rule
vini.o_assistente_monta_o_prompt: The assistant builds the prompt for a photo for the launch post, with the manual's colors and light, and lists the manual pages each rule came from
vini.fotografia_gerada_por_ia_a: AI-generated photograph from the prompt: a studio work desk at night, hands composing metal type, cool side light and a single point of orange
vini.ele_responde_com_fundamento_encontra: Vini answers with a basis, finds the right material, points out when two pieces of guidance don't match and recognizes when there is no safe answer. Vini consults the manual, the approved supplements and the brand's materials.
vini.a_orientacao_com_a_fonte: The guidance with its source and page. The citation opens the manual there.
vini.aponta_o_arquivo_certo_em: Points to the right file in Brand materials.
vini.quando_duas_orientacoes_documentadas_nao: When two documented pieces of guidance don't match, Vini shows both.
vini.sem_resposta_segura_diz_e: With no safe answer, Vini says so and suggests who to confirm with.
vini.a_orientacao_com_a_pagina: The guidance, with the page. One click on the citation takes the manual to it, without closing the conversation. Whatever is a draft appears labeled.
vini.a_orientacao_nao_so_veja: The guidance itself, not just "see the page"
vini.qual_e_a_area_de: What is the protection area of the symbol?
vini.e_x_nos_quatro_lados: It is x on all four sides. For the symbol alone, x equals one third of its height. No text or image enters that space.
vini.fonte_manual_do_brennimark_area: Source: Brennimark manual · Protection area · p. 10
vini.posso_colocar_o_logo_em: Can I put the logo over a photo?
vini.sim_desde_que_a_foto: Yes, as long as the photo reads effortlessly: the area behind the logo should be clean, without faces, products or cluttered areas. The manual doesn't carry this rule in its main body; it comes from an approved supplement.
vini.fonte_complemento_o_logotipo_sobre: Source: Supplement "The logotype over photography" · Ready
vini.ele_compara_as_cores_com: Vini compares the colors with the palette and marks on the piece what it found, with the page of each piece of guidance. What it can't yet measure on its own appears as a manual check, for you to confirm.
vini.achados_com_a_orientacao_e: Findings with the guidance and the page
vini.sugestao_de_correcao_para_voce: Suggested fix, for you to decide
vini.voce_descreve_o_que_quer: You describe what you want to create. Vini adds colors, light, framing and what to avoid, with the page for each line. You review and use it.
vini.a_ideia_e_sua_a: The idea is yours; the brand comes along
vini.rascunho_fica_fora_do_prompt: Drafts stay out of the prompt, labeled
vini.a_imagem_gerada_com_este: The image generated with this prompt
vini.fora_do_brennimark_voce_revisa: , outside Brennimark. You review and decide what to use.
vini.chama_quando_precisar_e_ele: Call Vini when you need, and Vini steps aside when you go back to work. Three sizes, one for each moment.
vini.so_ele_no_canto_nao: Just Vini, in the corner. Doesn't cover the manual.
vini.uma_janela_para_perguntar_e: A window to ask and read.
vini.a_peca_e_os_achados: The piece and the findings, side by side.
vini.a_conversa_com_o_vini: The conversation with Vini belongs to whoever asked. To improve the product, we use aggregate numbers, without identifying anyone.
vini.ninguem_le_a_conversa_de: No one reads another person's conversation: not the account owner, not the Brennimark team. We use statistics only, without identifying who asked.
vini.quando_quiser_fica_so_o: whenever they like. Only the usage record stays, without the content.
vini.o_vini_inventa_regra_quando: Does Vini make up rules when it doesn't know?
vini.nao_quando_o_manual_nao: No. When the manual doesn't cover the subject, Vini says there is no documented guideline and shows where it looked.
vini.nao_ele_aponta_o_que: No. Vini points out what it found and the matching rule. Approval belongs to the team.
vini.cada_plano_tem_um_limite: Each plan has a Vini usage limit, and extra usage can be bought separately.
vini.a_peca_que_eu_envio: Who keeps the piece I upload?
vini.com_a_marca_so_quem: The brand does. Only people with access to that brand see the analysis.
